_comment: Three base_url forms. JSON has no comments; this key is ignored by the engine and preserved on write.

host    http://127.0.0.1:4445                  — a model server on the HOST. In the Docker image FABULIST_HOST_ALIAS=host.docker.internal (set by docker-compose.yml) rewrites only the loopback host, so the container reaches the host machine instead of itself.
sidecar http://fabulist-models:8080/v1         — the models sidecar the default docker-compose.yml starts; a compose SERVICE name on the same network, NEVER rewritten.
An empty FABULIST_HOST_ALIAS disables the rewrite; LAN IPs and remote hosts are always left alone. See README.md > Configuration.

reasoning_effort (optional) is the reasoning DEPTH for a thinking model: the provider's own top-level body field of that name. Null or absent sends NOTHING, so a connection that never declares it is unaffected. Documented values: max | xhigh | high | medium | low | minimal | none (where the field is documented the default is 'max', and one model may accept only a subset). A value outside that set fails the config load, and a call-site value still wins.

A failing HTTP status whose body names a business error code is surfaced WITH that code in the turn's error, alongside the phase and the model, so a platform content filter reads differently from a network fault — see docs/decisions (ADR-023).
